name: Dollywood's DreamMore Resort and Spa
description: Dollywood's DreamMore Resort and Spa is the park's official resort, opened on 27 July 2015 with more than 300 rooms. It sits about 1.3 mi (2 km) from the park, and a free trolley runs to Dollywood and Splash Country. Guests receive TimeSaver passes, transportation and preferred parking. Typical rates run from about $220 to $470 a night.

rooms.description: Comfortable resort room for couples or small families.

rooms.description: Larger room with extra space for families.

name: Dollywood's HeartSong Lodge & Resort
description: Dollywood's HeartSong Lodge & Resort opened on 3 November 2023 with 302 rooms, next to DreamMore. It is an official park resort with a free trolley to Dollywood and perks such as TimeSaver passes and preferred parking. Rates seen at launch ranged from about $199 to $374 a night.

rooms.name: King Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room with a king bed.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Larger suite with a separate sitting area.

name: Black Fox Lodge Pigeon Forge, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
description: Black Fox Lodge Pigeon Forge is a Tapestry Collection by Hilton hotel about 1.6 mi (2.6 km) from Dollywood. It is a good base for guests who prefer a Hilton-brand stay close to the park. Typical rates run from about $237 to $293 a night.

rooms.name: Double Queen Room
rooms.description: Room with two queen beds, suited to families.

name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Pigeon Forge Resort
description: Embassy Suites by Hilton Pigeon Forge Resort is an all-suite hotel about 1.7 mi (2.7 km) from Dollywood, popular with families who like extra space. Typical rates run from about $184 to $297 a night.

rooms.name: King Suite
rooms.description: Two-room suite with a king bed and a separate living area.

rooms.name: Double Queen Suite
rooms.description: Two-room suite with two queen beds for families.

name: Wild Bear Inn
description: Wild Bear Inn is a budget-friendly option about 1.6 mi (2.6 km) from Dollywood. Typical rates run from about $87 to $113 a night, which makes it one of the cheaper choices near the park.
